reason: The Azure CLI has no az search index command group (az search covers the service, keys, networking and usage only). Create, update or read an index through the data-plane REST API, for example curl -X PUT "$SEARCH/indexes/<name>?api-version=2026-04-01" with a Bearer token from az account get-access-token --resource https://search.azure.com, or through an Azure SDK SearchIndexClient.

The costmanagement CLI extension has no query command (it has export and show-operation-result only). Call the Cost Management Query API with az rest --method post --url "https://management.azure.com/<scope>/providers/Microsoft.CostManagement/query?api-version=2026-06-01" --body <query definition>.

defaultConfiguration is an index property (semantic.defaultConfiguration in the index definition), not a search service property. Set the service's semantic ranker plan with az search service update --semantic-search free|standard, and the default semantic configuration in the index schema.
